cross_paper_synthesis.consensus: The provided evidence establishes a consensus that the stability of single-phase solid solutions in CrMoNbWV refractory HEAs is governed by thermodynamic criteria involving lattice distortion (δ) and interaction enthalpy (Ω), with a refined critical threshold of δ ≤ 6.6% and a strict inequality Ω > 1.1 (PMC7866258::reader_question::dc71f9094a2e2a7e::answer::a6fdcb84ce9bf914). It is also agreed that the empirical Hume–Rothery rules for binary systems are inapplicable to these complex multi-component systems, though the specific deviations are not detailed in the text (PMC7866258::reader_question::e25ffc73766664de::answer::e40139251ac87a30).
cross_paper_synthesis.different_approaches: Approaches vary between defining the parameters and attempting to calculate them. Some answers explicitly define the interaction parameter Ω_ij as 4H_mix_AB but note the lack of clarity on its derivation from the Miedema model (PMC7866258::reader_question::2d06ba3a52953790::answer::5f33b23f27d10b54). Other sections cite the existence of data tables (Table 7) containing Tm and |H_mix| but acknowledge the data is missing from the provided evidence (PMC7866258::reader_question::ea7034db6eb233e1::answer::cff23f5bfd5b97b4). Similarly, while a VEC of 5.6 is used to predict BCC formation, the elemental breakdown of this sum is absent (PMC7866258::reader_question::ab34ea4ec58d38af::answer::641b11ae421249d1).
cross_paper_synthesis.condition_dependencies: The formation of a single-phase solid solution is condition-dependent on the specific inequality Ω > 1.1; the text implies that a value exactly equal to 1.1 does not satisfy the stability criterion, creating a boundary limit rather than a guaranteed inclusion zone (PMC7866258::reader_question::dc71f9094a2e2a7e::answer::a6fdcb84ce9bf914). The parameter δ has a refined condition of ≤ 6.6% (PMC7866258::reader_question::dc71f9094a2e2a7e::answer::a6fdcb84ce9bf914), distinct from an earlier threshold of 6.4% cited in the text (PMC7866258::reader_question::e24b0cfd4b8d7648::answer::e17f2e67f94ad8c5).
cross_paper_synthesis.contradictions: There are no direct scientific contradictions in the provided text. However, there is an apparent evolution in the critical value for δ from 6.4% (PMC7866258::reader_question::e24b0cfd4b8d7648::answer::e17f2e67f94ad8c5) to a refined 6.6% (PMC7866258::reader_question::dc71f9094a2e2a7e::answer::a6fdcb84ce9bf914), which the text attributes to refinement in References [23] and [24] but does not explicitly explain the reasons for this shift or confirm if the specific CrMoNbWV alloy falls within the old or new ranges (PMC7866258::reader_question::4cda8117887bf327::answer::cb1c4114fdba757a).
cross_paper_synthesis.evidence_strength: The evidence strength is mixed: the criteria thresholds (δ and Ω values) are explicitly cited as established facts (PMC7866258::reader_question::dc71f9094a2e2a7e::answer::a6fdcb84ce9bf914), but the supporting input data required for calculation (atomic radii, elemental VEC values, Tm, and |H_mix|) are consistently reported as missing from the provided text spans (PMC7866258::reader_question::e24b0cfd4b8d7648::answer::e17f2e67f94ad8c5, PMC7866258::reader_question::ab34ea4ec58d38af::answer::641b11ae421249d1, PMC7866258::reader_question::ea7034db6eb233e1::answer::cff23f5bfd5b97b4).
cross_paper_synthesis.unresolved_gap: The primary unresolved gap is the absence of the specific input parameters (atomic radii, elemental VECs, melting points, and mixing enthalpies) required to independently verify if the calculated δ and Ω values for the CrMoNbWV alloy actually meet the stated stability criteria (PMC7866258::reader_question::2d06ba3a52953790::answer::5f33b23f27d10b54, PMC7866258::reader_question::e24b0cfd4b8d7648::answer::e17f2e67f94ad8c5, PMC7866258::reader_question::ea7034db6eb233e1::answer::cff23f5bfd5b97b4). Additionally, the physical justification for refining the δ threshold from 6.4% to 6.6% is missing (PMC7866258::reader_question::4cda8117887bf327::answer::cb1c4114fdba757a).
